text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
President Rudolf, Mr. C.B. I look forward 
to today's joint training session.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, wanting to join in on a mountain 
trail sprint... You sure are a curious 
one.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We shall run nonstop all the way to the 
summit. Steel your resolve, Mihono 
Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... footing is poor— 
Unable to... generate speed...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However, those two are—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Phew. It seems you managed to outpace me 
once again. Your speed remains as 
formidable as ever.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Look who's talking, Rudolf! You didn't 
break a sweat all the way to the finish. 
Not very cute, you know~.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, looks like Bourbon made it too.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*... *wheeze*...! Course... 
completed...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
High spirits to the end, well run. Come, 
let us rest at the mountain lodge cafe 
nearby.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... I appreciate your 
kindness—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, I cannot accept that order. It is 
time... to proceed to the next operation: 
"Side-by-Side Sprinting."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Haah... haah...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
How about it? The sheer pressure of 
running surrounded by us! The only one who 
has ever endured this is our King!

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Do not get ahead of yourselves. This is 
still not enough.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre's Retainer B
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, sir!! Then, let us continue!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(Kh... Orfe-san's form is still completely 
stable... I must... reach that power 
too—!)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Brian-san... let us begin... Operation: 
"Joint... Training"—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph. I have no use for dead weight.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Kh... all systems normal. I was merely 
performing recovery on my shoelaces.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Ninety... six...! Ninety... seven...!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Haah... haah... haah!! Dash set 10... 
complete...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, you're actually keeping up.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: However... the real training starts now!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah haah haah... Physical strain... 
reaching critical limit. However—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I have an order... that I must fulfill!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order: Transform myself into someone 
worthy of the Triple Crown!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaahhhhhhh!!

Work had finished and late into the night, 
the students should have all been gone, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Brian-san... Scheduled order... 
accomplished.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Please train with me again. ...I want to 
become stronger.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh... suit yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However... entering sleep mode... in 
three, two...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Get some rest already. I'm satisfied for 
today as well.
